summary: School expresses concern about preserving E-Rate funding to maintain essential services and infrastructure for schools and libraries.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, schools would face significant financial burdens and potential changes to their business models.
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, if we lost these funds it would be a huge impact to our system of charter schools. Our board of directors would have to look at our business model and absolutely have to make some changes.
